findings.reason: Rejected as a present missing-dependency/build-order defect at atlas commit 04f16aefbba9a011245937c20c0057df14ba10ac. The seven original-snapshot exports really have empty prerequisites, and the three prose dependencies are real. However, the finding treats those snapshot exports as the assembled atlas. Accepted data/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_LocalFieldsRamification.json already supplies LocalFieldsRamification -> QuadraticFormInvariants, including Layers 0/1/2 -> sublayer 6A (links[2:5]); accepted data/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_NumberFieldArithmetic.json supplies LocalFieldsRamification Layer 0 -> NumberFieldArithmetic Layer 5 (links[2]) and NumberFieldArithmetic Layer 2 -> GlobalNumberFields Layer 2 for the exact idealsAway/integralIdealsAway carriers (links[45]). These packets were independently accepted on 2026-09-23. Running scripts.build.assemble(require_distances=False) reproduces all three roadmap edges, with respectively 7, 5 and 6 supporting stage edges, and nonempty prerequisites for all seven roadmaps. scripts/build.py:61-78 preserves the original snapshot and applies reviewed links; decompositions.merge_links and merge_decompositions, then blueprints.refresh_roadmap_links, propagate these into stage and roadmap adjacency. In contrast, research/blueprint/make_atlas_extracts.py:40-75 reads data/atlas.json, not the assembled graph, and the extracts README explicitly prohibits hand editing. No new edges or edits to generated prerequisites are justified. A separately scoped improvement could expose assembled dependencies to browser workers, but that is an exporter/documentation task, not the proposed insertion of absent mathematical dependencies. Also narrow the build-order rhetoric: the actual Tau Ceti pin already defines idealsPrimeTo and integralIdealsPrimeTo as abbreviations of the existing NumberFieldArithmetic carriers (Global/RayClass/Modulus.lean:442-444,471-472; Ideal/Away.lean:54-64,117-124), so this is neither an unbuilt-carrier gap nor an obligation to finish an entire supplier roadmap first. The raw snapshot itself disclaims a complete dependency audit. Its current count is 162/212 nonempty roadmap lists, not the report's historical 161/211. This verdict does not endorse the report's broader clean library/omission claims and does not determine when the dependencies first became available.
